title: Outlines of mineralogy
author: Torbern Bergman

authorInfo.bio: Torbern Bergman (1735–1784) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Outlines of Mineralogy" by Torbern Bergman is a scientific publication written in the late 18th century. The work offers a systematic approach to the study of minerals, focusing on their component parts and properties, providing foundational knowledge for the discipline of mineralogy.
longDescription: Source subjects: Mineralogy -- Early works to 1800; Mineralogical chemistry -- Early works to 1800.
